name: Winter Wraith
storyline:
Twin meteors fell on the continent a thousand years ago, making advancements possible. Fortunes fell and rose with the newly established connection to the nine realms freeing the demons from the grip of Undead, and humans from the Demons themselves.

With the introduction of soul element to life in the continent, Harmonium was established between Kingdom of humans and the interplanetary beings of Harmonium to make life peaceful in the continent. While Demonium still keeps the old traditions, both sides keep innovating according to circumstance.

The situation recently changed, as the stray souls are starting to cause mayhem in the countryside, while the big towns are protected by various spirit shields, each according to their own technology and culture.
summary:
You are tasked with investigating a mysterious disease in the south west. Armies are moving rapidly in the trench. You don't have much time before more important matters call to your attention. Solve your first task and get back to the Harmonium for the next.

You will play as one of the great heroes of the continent, leading and managing your own minor faction: Ankh among others at the great Fortress of Harmonium.

The game includes everything a classic infinity engine RPG usually does, you will solve quests and gain experience, many times by fighting. It also includes huge field battles (on table top), faction management, romance and friendships, crafting and alchemy, resource harvesting, as well as many many others.
